# Huy Nguyen

> Huy Nguyen is an open-source engineer focused on Flutter, accessibility, Material Design, and community knowledge sharing. This is his personal site at huynq.dev — technical writing, talks, open-source projects, and Flutter framework contributions.

Personal website of Huy Nguyen (GitHub: [@huycozy](https://github.com/huycozy) for Flutter contributions, [@huynguyennovem](https://github.com/huynguyennovem) for projects). Content covers Flutter framework internals, engine compilation, iOS/desktop integration, publishing, and open-source contribution workflows.

Key facts:
- Flutter framework contributor (Material widgets, accessibility/semantics)
- Open-source engineer with experience at Codemagic on Flutter issue triage and fixes
- Speaker at GDG DevFest Hanoi and community events
- Author of Flutter packages and indie apps (NetShare, MenGauge, CompactKit)
- Site: https://huynq.dev

---

## Projects and Packages

- [NetShare](https://netfshare.site/): Open-source Flutter app for sharing data on a local network
- [MenGauge](https://mengauge.app): Indie Flutter app on Android and iOS
- [CompactKit](https://compactkit.cc/): Compress and optimize photos, videos, PDFs, documents, and code
- [open_dir](https://pub.dev/packages/open_dir): Flutter plugin to open a native directory on desktop
- [uni_selected_button](https://pub.dev/packages/uni_selected_button): Flutter single-select button group widget
- [netshare_saf](https://github.com/NetShareOSS/netshare_saf): Android Storage Access Framework APIs for NetShare-style apps
